Mike H: FYI — after yesterday's kernel-hint rollout (auto-kernel-v2) we see a throughput regression on Mistral-7B with GQA enabled. p95/p99 up ~12-18% on the 16k-token synthetic bench :thinking:
Sara L: saw same on staging. Kernel chooser picked generic_attn instead of fused_attn for heads=16, kv_dim=64 combos. reproable with our perf harness.
Ben R: quick check — does this affect MQA configs too or only GQA?
Mike H: mostly GQA so far. MQA looks stable but smaller samples. suspect interplay between RoPE scaling normalization and kernel heuristics.
Carmen P: attached profiler snippet from staging run (timestamps stripped):
```
kernel_name           calls   total_ms   avg_ms
fused_attn_f16        420     1900.2     4.52
generic_attn_f16      180     1600.7     8.89
kv_cache_page_load    90      210.3      2.34

note: generic_attn used on layers 6-12 when num_kv_heads==16
```
Sara L: looks like generic_attn avg is ~2x fused. Kernel selector rule that chose generic for head_dim<64 might be too aggressive after RoPE scale patch.
Mike H: repro command I used in harness:
```
./bench_infer --model mistral-7b --seq-len 16384 --batch 8 --gqa --num-kv-heads 16 --kv-dim 64 --max-batch-tokens 32768 --kernel-hint auto-kernel-v2
```
Ben R: tried forcing the kernel via env var and perf returned to baseline:
`ATTN_KERNEL=attention_fused_float16 ./bench_infer ...`
Carmen P: interesting — also observed more paged-KV fragmentation in those runs. Page allocator logs show many small free segments after GC which may increase page load ops per request.
Sara L: fragmentation + kernel switch = double-whammy. When pages are fragmented, KV read path does extra scatter-gather and forces generic fallback more often.
Mike H: can someone run these three quick tests and drop numbers here? 1) baseline (pre-rollout) config 2) current auto-kernel-v2 3) auto-kernel-v2 + ATTENTION_FORCE=fused
Sara L: running now on staging-1, will post numbers (ETA ~12m) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Ben R: also include a run with num_kv_heads=8 (MQA-like) and one with kv_dim=128 so we can isolate head_dim effect.
Carmen P: note for later — consider adding a kernel-hint override that prefers fused when paged-kv fragmentation rate > X% or kv-loads/sec > Y. otherwise heuristics too opaque.
Mike H: agreed. If we need quick mitigation: revert the kernel hint rollout or add a temporary rule mapping (model=mistral-7b & gqa & heads>=16) -> prefer fused_attn.
Sara L: numbers from staging-1 (short):
- baseline (pre-rollout): throughput=112 req/s, p99=92ms
- auto-kernel-v2: throughput=93 req/s, p99=110ms
- auto-kernel-v2 + ATTENTION_FORCE=fused: throughput=115 req/s, p99=88ms
- num_kv_heads=8 (auto-kernel-v2): throughput=109 req/s, p99=95ms
- kv_dim=128 (auto-kernel-v2): throughput=101 req/s, p99=103ms
Sara L: attaching perf links in thread — s3://redwood-perf/staging/mistral/1745523210/{profile,heap,alloc}.tgz :link: 
Ben R: those are pretty conclusive. kernel chooser misclassifying some head_dim combos + fragmentation. patch idea: tighten rule to prefer fused for kv_dim<=64 && heads>=16.
Carmen P: also raised that our prefix/KV cache compaction GC threshold might be too lenient for long seq runs. propose lowering fragmentation threshold from 0.25 -> 0.15 for paged alloc.
Mike H: I'll open a small rollback PR for the rollout and a follow-up hotfix with the rule change + compaction tweak. tagging infra-oncall @sara for permission to revert.
Sara L: ack, will coordinate. also will add a microbenchmark to test head_dim heuristic matrix across Llama/Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen variants.
perf-bot: scheduled bench job 1745523880 queued -> running on perf-pod-3. Full artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/mistral/gqa-1745523210/summary.json
Mike H: thanks all. keeping this thread for postmortem notes. please paste any extra logs or oddities here. :thumbsup:
